reviews.review_description: Suppliers through your website contacted me promptly and were all very informative and helpful. Service to the Islands was variable but generally good. Without naming - one had two adverse reports from the limited number of former customers I spoke to and another had one.My final choice was mainly from local references. They were not the cheapest but they are highly regarded on the Islands and I could not fault their service. Warranties were equal or better than  other equipment supplied. They are long time residents in a restricted community and have a reputation for backup service on all their electrical work.
